name: Amenomori Renji
source: A third-year at Tsubakimachi High School. He is a fan of the Sengoku period, Romance of the Three Kingdoms and mecha anime. Renji thinks he is the one with most common sense out of his team (because it's full of weirdoes), but in reality he's not.
